text:
You're not single. You're showing up like a boy.

A bare face reads boyish. Kills attraction before you speak.

Any man over 18 needs facial hair. A beard, stubble, a goatee. Even stubble signals testosterone and adds an edge.

Maintenance is everything. Shape it. Clean lines.

Find what fits your face. Experiment. Then commit.

Your beard is the difference. Teenager or man.
caption:
Most men think their dating problems come from money or height. They don't. That's not mindset. It's showing up like a boy.

Send this to a man who needs it today.
